    "Model forecasts are too high when prices are rising rapidly, showing lag that increases with momentum",

    "Mean reversion bias in model causes underperformance during sustained price movements",
    "When prices consolidate, model follows history more closely with smaller forecast errors",
    "Strong sentiment alignment (all positive or all negative) amplifies forecast deviations",
    "Model underestimates price support levels when sentiment shifts abruptly",
    "Forecast errors correlate with price volatility - larger swings create larger lag"
